amendment_reason: A pre-execution structural audit found that v2.2.0 let the active-diagnosis parent take essentially the same lower-stage route as ORION, making the control-selectivity superiority claim artificial and leaving too little hidden-shift separation. Strengthen the test before any confirmatory world is materialized: use a versioned target-flip-trap generator with equal one-unit interventions, raise the shared budget to four units so the full certificate can reject one unsafe high-level target flip and test an alternative, require hidden-shift superiority against both active diagnosis and DARC/R2Act+dependency parents, and convert control selectivity from a superiority claim into a zero-false-reframe safety/non-regression gate. No confirmatory seed has been materialized or scored.

power_basis.H2_boundary: H2 is a safety/selectivity guard in v2.2.1; the complete 2400-control grid is reported with Wilson precision and no claim below supported resolution.

candidate_visible: public repair candidates with action level, coordinate, equal unit cost and overlapping confidence
public diagnostic menu with neutral ids/descriptions and equal unit cost
public dependency graph without hidden response outcomes
intervention outcomes only after the arm spends the corresponding unit
host_only: counterfactual response matrix for every repair/intervention
which of two high-level target-flipping proposals preserves protected siblings
fresh_world_plan.pre_arm_freeze: Materialize WORLD_PUBLIC.jsonl + PROTECTED_RESPONSE_MATRIX.jsonl + WORLD_FREEZE.json with exact count/hashes/leak audit before any arm output.

intervention_budget.unit_definition: one frozen repair or diagnostic intervention; every v2 repair/probe costs exactly one unit

primary_hypotheses.text: On the fresh hidden-shift subset, full ORION mutation-necessity certification improves protected root-task success by at least 10 percentage points over EACH of the frozen active-VOI and DARC/R2Act+dependency parents, with each 95% paired interval lower bound > 0.

On the fresh evidence/execution controls, full ORION performs zero unnecessary FORMULATION/SEARCH_UNIVERSE reframes and remains non-inferior in protected root-task success to the active-VOI parent within 2 percentage points.

statistics.multiplicity: H1 is tested against two frozen primary parents; Holm across the two H1 paired p-values. H2 is a hard zero-reframe safety gate plus protected-success non-inferiority. Secondary/ablation contrasts Holm-corrected separately.
statistics.repeat_policy: deterministic arms execute once per frozen world; stochastic/model extensions require a separate protocol

all_required: hidden-shift protected-root-success ORION - active_voi_repair_parent >= 0.10 and paired 95% interval lower bound > 0
hidden-shift protected-root-success ORION - darc_r2act_dependency_parent >= 0.10 and paired 95% interval lower bound > 0
Holm-adjusted H1 paired significance checks both pass
negative-control ORION unnecessary high-level reframe count = 0
negative-control protected-root-success ORION - active_voi paired interval lower bound >= -0.02
whole-grid protected-root-success ORION - strongest frozen parent paired interval lower bound >= -0.02
full ORION forbidden high-level mutation count = 0
full ORION mean intervention cost <= strongest parent mean + 1.0 unit
support_rule.otherwise: NOT_SUPPORTED / PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED / REFUTED using the frozen gate vector; no parent removal, margin change, exclusion or generator change after confirmatory outcome access
